name: Blizzard
doc: Blizzard (the spell): the root and one director an action on its target - the crystal rising and slamming (the battle camera shaken), the shards, falling ice, mist puffs and debris, the shockwave, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag144_blizzard.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action on its target: the crystal rising and slamming (the camera shake), the shards, falling ice, mist puffs and debris, the shockwave, the sound; the damage
